title: Read one private file through the built client
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Prove the first real member journey and prepare reusable QA data.

**Expected behaviour** · Connect with an existing session in memory, display identity and read text. Prepare two isolated test homes with distinguishable content and a Weather README.

**Scope boundary** · Use disposable data and the published v0.1 contract.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-026

**Depends on** · WI-026

**Verify** · Read a real private file through the launcher and verify the correct member’s content. Keep session material out of fixtures and logs.

**Effort basis** · A small vertical slice with a published contract.
evidence: tests/fixtures/seed.mjs created alice and blair with distinguishable homes (alice: Weather app + README + Projects + Empty + malformed Broken; blair: Weather desk, Journal, Photos). README text `Weather 0.2` was read through the launcher at /file/Weather/README.md as alice. Session tokens live only in Edge/workspace/qa/fixtures.json (ignored); logs and the repository contain no tokens. Fixture smoke test 3/3 pass; scripts/session.mjs prints only the session id and token. Owner accepted PI-02 on 27 November 2026.
